Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds column (pp5-6); Bond proceeds 754,890 printed inside total revenues recorded as debt_proceeds (reported_totals includes debt_proceeds). Governmental spending is listed by object only; functions assigned by dominant fund with review. The all-funds budget schedule (p10) is a combined schedule and is not recorded (replaced by per-fund lines). p5 nonmajor Personnel services 46,136 = p9 Personnel 45,926 + Professional fees 210. Proprietary statement p8 labels the 101,890/45,593 column Water, while the Statement of Activities and budget schedule show those figures as Sewer. Component unit (Library) excluded. Balance sheet: assets from Statement of Net Position total column; governmental equity by classification from the governmental funds statement (totals equal government-wide), business-type unrestricted from p1.
